## Reviewer 2

### Summary

To address this challenge, the authors introduce an AutoRegressive Transformer framework for LF-STVG (ART-STVG). The framework incorporates spatial and temporal memory banks to capture spatio-temporal context, and employs memory selective strategies to focus on relevant information. Additionally, a cascaded spatio-temporal design connects the spatial and temporal decoders, allowing for more precise temporal localization in complex long videos.
